newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade slow at $66.00-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade slow at $66.00-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sales Friday were slow, with light sales at $66.00 per cwt reported, steady with this week's top and up $2.00 from last week's top price, feedlot sources said.

About 200 slaughter steers and 100 heifers, which will likely grade select and choice sold in the Texas Panhandle/ western Oklahoma area Friday, following a weekly movement of 115,600 in that area, USDA said.
No sales were reported in Kansas on Friday following weekly movement there of 108,400 head, USDA said.
